Here is a C++ program that generates a table.

#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

void generateTable(int rows, int cols) {
    // Generate the table header
    cout << " + ";
    for (int i = 0; i < cols; i++) {
        cout << "-";

        if (i < cols - 1)
            cout << " | ";

    }
    cout << endl;
}

int main() {
    srand(time(0)); // Seed the random number generator
    int rows, cols;
    cout << "Enter the number of rows: ";
    cin >> rows;
    generateTable(rows, cols);
    return 0;
}

Compile it with g++ table.cpp and run the result.
